subject: Detecting emotions
source_sentence: This work addresses the task of detecting emotions (e.g., happy, sad, angry, etc.) in textual conversations
title: Knowledge-Enriched Transformer for Emotion Detection in Textual Conversations

subject: Transformer
source_sentence: The Transformer has been applied to many NLP tasks due to its rich representation and fast computation, e.g., document machine translation , response matching in dialogue system , language modelling and understanding.
title: Knowledge-Enriched Transformer for Emotion Detection in Textual Conversations

subject: Graph Attention
source_sentence: To enrich word embedding with concept representations, we propose a dynamic context-aware affective graph attention mechanism to compute the concept representation for each token.
title: Knowledge-Enriched Transformer for Emotion Detection in Textual Conversations
